Each item names its target repo. The Nestimate-side items also live in Nestimate/todo/COVERAGE-CATCHUP.md; this file is the superset with the text/NLP framing. Checked 2026-08-24: none of these exist anywhere on CRAN.

Nestimate (statistical R core)

Saqrlab (simulation)

carm-text / carm-ml (JS side, if ever)

Reading order (papers/)

  1. 2022-TIST-TextClassificationSurvey-Li.pdf — umbrella background (supervised, through GCN; stops before hypergraphs).
  2. 2006-NeurIPS-LearningWithHypergraphs-Zhou.pdf — the Laplacian everything else builds on; directly implementable.
  3. 2019-ICML-HypergraphRW-Chitra.pdf — random-walk spectral theory, edge-dependent vertex weights. 2b. 2020-CIKM-HypergraphClustering-Hayashi.pdf — EDVW clustering built on (2); the unsupervised method to implement.
  4. 2020-EMNLP-HyperGAT-Ding.pdf — text hypergraph construction + dual attention (construction verified in their repo, see README).
  5. 2019-EMNLP-HGAT-Linmei.pdf — topic/entity heterogeneous predecessor.
  6. 2019-AAAI-HGNN-Feng.pdf, 2019-NeurIPS-HyperGCN-Yadati.pdf, 2020-HNHN-Dong.pdf, 2022-ICLR-AllSet-Chien.pdf — the neural lineage, in order.
  7. 2019-NeurIPS-XLNet-Yang.pdf — PLM baseline context only.
